deep.note: Snow Media is checking this box until {{date}}

check.rowDesc: Plays your last channel for 30 seconds, looks at your box, internet and the stream, and sends the result to Snow Media.
check.withReport: Run a 30-second check and send it with your report
check.title: 30-second check
check.notSent: Couldn't send it now — it will be sent later.
check.unavailable: The check can't run right now (6 a day at most).
check.backToSkip: Back stops the check; your report is still sent.

verdict.fine: No problem found: the stream came in at {{arrival}} and your internet is {{internet}}.
verdict.unclear: We couldn't pin it down: the stream came in at {{arrival}} and your internet is {{internet}}. Snow Media will look at the details.
verdict.notPlaying: Nothing played during the check. Your internet is {{internet}}.
verdict.overloadMemory: Your box is overloaded: only {{mem}} MB of memory was free. Restarting the box usually helps.
verdict.overloadCpu: Your box is overloaded: its processor ran at {{cpu}}%. Restarting the box usually helps.
verdict.internet: Your internet is the problem: {{internet}}, and the stream needs {{needed}}.
verdict.weakWifi: Your Wi-Fi signal is weak (internet {{internet}}). Move the router closer or use a cable.
verdict.offline: Your box lost its internet connection during the check.
verdict.server: Your box is fine and your internet is {{internet}}, but the stream server only sent {{arrival}} of the {{needed}} it needs.
verdict.account: The service refused your line. Check your subscription.
